title: Paused bookmark
idea: A paper disc with Shelf's bookmark punched out of it and a paper pause left standing in the hole: Richard's three levels turned inside out, so the bookmark is the dark of the screen showing through the paper. A bookmark is a pause in reading, so the pause inside it says 'come back to this' and 'you can listen' at once, and on the light colourway the same drawing gives his solid light bookmark with a dark pause in it, held in an ink disc.
built: Disc r 32 dp about the centre, reaching 32.0 of the 33 dp safe radius. Today's bookmark at today's width, 34 dp, every proportion from geom.bookmark's defaults (shoulders r 4, notch 11 deep, tips r 1.5); its box sits 0.5 dp below the disc's centre, because the notch lightens its foot and a centred box looks high. Pause bars 5.5 x 18 dp with a 5.5 dp gap and r 1.5, the tips' radius, so the drawing has only two radii; the pause is centred 17 dp below the bookmark's top edge, a little below the middle of the body above the notch, because the V under the bars reads as extra room. The narrowest paper is 5.6 dp between the tips and the disc's edge and 6.3 dp between the bars and the notch, both above the 4.5 dp that becomes 3 px at 48.
small: 48 px: disc r 21, bookmark 22 x 27 with a 7 px notch and r 3 shoulders, bars 4 x 12 with a 4 px gap; every straight edge on whole pixels, so only the disc's rim and the notch are soft (11.6%). 32 px: disc r 14, bookmark 14 x 18 with a 5 px notch, bars 2 x 8 with a 2 px gap, at least 2 px of paper everywhere. 16 px: the pause drops out; the disc is a hand-stepped 14 px circle on whole pixels and the bookmark is 6 x 9 with a 3 px notch at 45 degrees, as Shelf's own small cuts have it (6.5% soft against the solid reference's 14.7). Glyph: disc r 10 with a 10 x 12 bookmark hole and no pause, so the status bar never shows what looks like a paused control while Shelf is reading aloud.
risks: The paper disc makes this the brightest icon on a dark home screen and moves it away from the dark icon Richard described; it is 42% paper against the solid reference's 33%. A light disc with a dark mark can read as a button, and the pause could suggest a media app at a glance, although the bookmark's square shoulders and notch read first at launcher sizes. A bookmark in a circle also echoes Telegram's Saved Messages avatar, a white bookmark on a blue disc. The pause is gone at 16 px and in the glyph, so the toolbar and the status bar show a plain bookmark disc.
